change: Scan runs of eight ASCII spaces with an in-bounds unaligned-safe memcpy into uint64_t; retain the exact scalar JSON whitespace predicate for all other bytes and short tails. No schema, semantic visitor, compiler flags, dependency checks, macro scan, mutation guards or memory-concurrency policy changed.
decision: Retain the bounded portable implementation: both sequential full-manifest comparisons improved, including reversed run order. Benefit is modest and host/cache sensitive; do not present the best observed percentage as a guaranteed speedup.

environment.method: Control executable copied before the production edit; both use the same current scanner, source inputs and ordered native_board_policy_audit_sources manifest. Sequential runs, no concurrent builds/tests, no source changes during timing. OS caches and external host load uncontrolled.

new_regression_coverage: Memory and streaming inputs: runs of 0/1/7/8/9/15/16/17/65535/65536/65537 spaces; mixed JSON tab/CR/LF; leading/interior/trailing whitespace; exact consumed-byte accounting; whitespace-only incomplete input; rejection of VT, FF, NUL and 0xA0 after every tested run. Existing generic-parser projection oracle and malformed skipped-field tests remain active.
scope_limits: These are source-audit times, not compilation, placement, rendering, total board build, or Python comparison timings. No new board qualification or layout change. Persistent reuse and compiler-output reduction are not enabled. Overall goal remains incomplete.
